observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor grassy area under trees on a sunny day with a rustic wooden fence in the background
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women, approximately 10 dancers
observation.formation_and_space: starts with a single couple dancing, then others join in circles, lines, and pairs moving around the space
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees, upright weight distribution
observation.footwork: springy steps, hopping, skipping, and quick foot lifts on the beats
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held at sides, waving overhead, clapping, or joined with partners in circles and lines
observation.hips_and_torso: upright with natural sway and rotation during turns and circling
observation.partnering: holding hands in circles or pairs, periodic paired turns and spinning
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing levels with small hops and frequent circular turns
observation.costume_and_props: traditional folk costumes with white shirts, colored striped skirts for women, vests and dark trousers for men, hats, and headbands
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and subtle weight shifts due to wide camera angles and grass terrain
